description:
memory.rs:87-100, plus memory.rs:643-655, memory.rs:735-748, memory.rs:782-795 — the ChangeRecord struct stores related_type and type_name as String. The rustdoc and the call sites both note these strings are 'empty for non-Metadata types':

    related_type: val.get("relatedType").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("").to_owned(),
    type_name: val.get("@type").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("").to_owned(),

This is a sentinel-string pattern. Empty string means 'this is a non-Metadata record'. The struct invariant is: for Metadata::TYPE_NAME entries these fields are populated; for any other type they are empty.

In current code, MemoryBackend only stores Metadata objects, so the non-Metadata branch is unreachable in practice. The conditional empty-string is defensive only — and the defense itself is just to satisfy the compiler.

Suggested rewrite: make the metadata-specific snapshot an Option<(String, String)> field on ChangeRecord:

    struct ChangeRecord {
        id: Id,
        metadata_tags: Option<MetadataTags>,
    }
    struct MetadataTags { related_type: String, type_name: String }

…or, since the snapshot is only meaningful for Metadata, lift the snapshot to a separate type-specific change-log key:

    metadata_change_log: HashMap<account_id, Vec<MetadataChangeEntry>>

…separate from the generic change_log. Then the snapshot is unconditional and the sentinel disappears.

Simpler rewrite that keeps the existing structure: replace  with  and make the fields Option<String>. The record_matches closure becomes:

    if let Some(rt) = filter_related_type {
        if rec.related_type.as_deref() != Some(rt) { return false; }
    }

…which preserves the current 'empty filters out' semantics with no sentinel value.

Cost of leaving: 4 call sites repeat the exact same unwrap_or-empty-string boilerplate. A 5th call site (any future MetadataBackend write op that also bumps the change log) will copy the same pattern. The convention is fragile — anyone forgetting the convention will write a code path that breaks the filter.

Severity: P3, elegance not correctness — current behavior is fine, but the structural shape encourages misuse.
title: ChangeRecord.related_type / type_name are empty strings for non-Metadata types — sentinel-string smell
